area: The status layer 'Your Harbor' (#/status, ui-status.js), the Today chip, the Harbor scene's place taps, the radar card on Track.

unitNotes.V-01a: The status page (3 h, V3-01): new offline/src/ui-status.js, namespace StatusUI, registered as UI.pages.status (ui-core.js pageKey accepts any registered segment: no core edit); one parts line in build.mjs after ui-harbor.js at the append point. Renders: HarborUI.scene(ctx) reused full width, with data-place='<region>' on each place (ui-harbor.js gets the attribute only) and a tap sheet listing that region's skills with level and uses from GameUI.model(gs).skills and the next level's count; 'Where you stand' from the same model object (GameUI.rankCard, xpBar, the badge count; total days only when counters are on and discreet is off; never the current run); 'Next small step' (the first undone Engine.explorer item, else Engine.nextLesson / Engine.roadmap().focus, else an open quest step; one link); Back to Today; an SOS link data-test status-sos (the chrome's #sos-btn stays). StatusUI.model(gs, extra) and StatusUI.diff(before, after) are pure (plain objects in, plain objects out; the diff lists rises only; a slip changes no level). Calm: no scene, XP or badges, the places as a plain list; discreet: no scene, no days; text as text, no innerHTML with data, no network. Hooks (data-test) exactly as PLAN-V3.md section 3: status-page, status-scene, status-place (data-region, data-level), status-stand, status-days, status-next, status-next-go, status-sos, status-back. offline/tests/status.test.mjs: model and diff pure and deterministic; a SkillUsed raises its region and the diff names it; a SlipLogged plus a slip log leaves every level equal and the diff empty; Calm and discreet rules; the page renders from an empty and a sample profile with no dead button and SOS one tap away; pure exports only. Done when #/status renders both profiles, every test passes by name, and the gates are green on the branch.
unitNotes.V-01b: What changed, what to watch, the way in (2 h, V3-01, V3-02): 'What just changed' = StatusUI.diff of the model since the page was last drawn (memory only, this session, like GameUI's seen): a light that grew (place, level), XP today, a badge, a rank, an Explorer step, a quest step, a day banked; the matching place pulses once (class hb-grew on ui-harbor.js's place, transform scale 300 ms, transform only; none under prefers-reduced-motion, data-motion=reduce or on an SOS route: the words carry it); first open 'Here is where you stand.'; hooks status-change, status-change-item (data-kind). The 14-day strip of dated dots from Engine.momentum(...).dates (status-strip, status-strip-day with data-date and data-active; a history, never a count headline; decision V-Q4). 'What to watch' from Engine.warningSigns(view, now) with each sign's plan (own plans win), gentle wording, never red, empty state 'Nothing to watch right now.' (status-watch, status-watch-item data-sign); the same card at #/track/radar in ui-track.js (closes V3-02: the revealed radar feature led to plain Track). Today: a 'Your harbor' chip in the header quick row beside Log a craving and SOS (data-test today-status, data-tour status-open) and the harbor card becomes a link (today-harbor-go); GuidanceUI.dot on the chip once Content.features.status exists (typeof-guarded). data-tour status-scene, status-change, status-watch on the page. The CSS in today-track's styles.css section. status.test.mjs grows: the diff after a quick log names the rise; reduced motion adds no moving class; the radar renders on #/track/radar; Today's chip routes to #/status. Done when the page shows a rise after a logged skill use and nothing after a slip, by test.
unitNotes.V-43: Today and Your Harbor show the three features (2 h, tier 1, R-O-6; after V-01b, and after the V-40, V-41, V-42 merges, on the contracts before): Today gets a 'Today's objectives' card (the three from Engine.dailyObjectives, tap to do through Actions.objective.done, one swap through Actions.objective.swap, the growth line), the run line in the header (current · best · total from Engine.run; 'kept' on a grace day; 'you came back' after a break; never a countdown or a shame line), and the quest-line's current step card with what it unlocks and the claim (Actions.questLine.claim; the reward sheet is game-tutorials' V-44, called behind typeof). Your Harbor: the growth elements drawn in the scene (one per Engine.growth unit, from the objective's grows kind; never removed; Calm shows the count as words; discreet unchanged), the spine 'Your way' (Engine.questLine steps done / current / locked with their rewards; locked steps show the title only), the run in 'Where you stand'. Hooks (data-test): objectives-card, objective (data-id, data-done), objective-done, objective-swap, run-line, run-current, run-best, run-total, run-kept, run-back, questline-card, questline-step (data-state), questline-claim, status-growth, status-growth-item, status-way. status.test.mjs and today-track.test.mjs grow by rule (a done objective adds one growth element and never removes one; a break shows 'you came back' and the same best and total).
